verdict.rationale: Docs show native integrations with Jira, Linear, ClickUp and Monday.com allowing the agent to update issue statuses, add comments, link PRs and create tasks, and specifically state connecting a Linear workspace 'enables agent interactions with your issues,' which directly supports assigning work from a ticket. Missing for 10: a concrete end-to-end example of assigning a task from an issue/ticket, and independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
